subject: [PATCH 08/16] selftests/mm: skip collapse_compound_extreme where the PMD is too large

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies a selftest in the Linux kernel to skip a test case where the PMD (Page Map Directory) size is too large for fault-time THP (Transparent Huge Pages) construction on certain architectures, specifically arm64/64K. The test case is skipped when the hpage_pmd_size exceeds 32M, but MADV_COLLAPSE-driven cases are still exercised to ensure PMD-order collapse functionality is tested on larger configurations. This change prevents the test from failing due to an inability to allocate a large number of pages.
